instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Keep one of a notification setting's options as this person's choice", and give it setting; choice.
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:choose-my-notification-choice and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: setting is the setting's name and choice one option id from tool:my-notification-choice.
4. It reads only its own rows, from the rows its caller gives it, and answers the rows it makes as keep for the caller to keep: notification-setting; notification-choice.
